'''Eianrod''' is a town in [[Cairhien]]. The town was abandoned during a civil war caused by [[King]] [[Galldrian Riatin]]'s assassination.

==Activities==
The town was still abandoned when [[Couladin]] and the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] passed through.{{ref/book|5|31}} [[Rand al'Thor]], his group, the Aiel, and [[Hadnan Kadere]] and his men camp in and near Eianrod.{{ref/book|5|29}}{{ref/book|5|30}}
